name: Merkium
description: Dutch model lab serving its own Ceres, Ganymede and Pluto models free of charge.
overview: Merkium is an independent Dutch model developer whose current API models carry no per-token or per-request charge: Ceres 1.0, Ganymede 1.1 and the Pluto 1.2 family, served through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The catalogue calls the models "free to use through the API, permanently" with no card or billing account, at 30 requests/minute per key, and states that conversations are never used to train, fine-tune or evaluate Merkium models.
free_access: Prompts are never used for training
notes: Small independent lab: space requests at least two seconds apart and honour Retry-After.
